title: Accelerating Variational Cone-Beam CT Reconstruction with Learned Warm Starts
abstract: arXiv:2611.18801v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Variational reconstruction provides a rigorous framework for cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) by combining an explicit acquisition model with image priors. However, iterative optimization remains computationally demanding, particularly under severe noise and sparse-view conditions. Although learning-based methods achieve high reconstruction quality, they often replace the original variational formulation with learned optimization schemes or nonlinear equilibrium models. We propose a neural network-guided warm-start framework that accelerates variational reconstruction while preserving its original formulation. Projection data are first reconstructed using the Feldkamp-Davis-Kress (FDK) algorithm, and the resulting image is refined by an image-domain neural network. The network output is used solely to initialize the subsequent model-based optimization, leaving the forward model, data-fidelity term, regularization, and optimization

translated_title: 基于学习式热启动加速变分锥束CT重建
translated_abstract: 变分重建通过将显式采集模型与图像先验相结合，为锥束计算机断层扫描（CBCT）提供了一个严谨的框架。然而，迭代优化在计算上仍然非常耗时，尤其是在严重噪声和稀疏视角条件下。尽管基于学习的方法能够实现较高的重建质量，但它们通常会用学习到的优化方案或非线性平衡模型来替代原始的变分公式。我们提出了一种神经网络引导的热启动框架，在保持原始变分公式的同时加速变分重建。首先使用Feldkamp-Davis-Kress（FDK）算法对投影数据进行重建，然后通过图像域神经网络对所得图像进行细化。网络输出仅用于初始化后续基于模型的优化过程，从而保持前向模型、数据保真项、正则化以及优化过程不变。
tldr: 提出一种神经网络引导的热启动框架，利用FDK重建加图像域神经网络的输出仅作为优化初始化，在完整保留原始变分公式（前向模型、数据保真项与正则化不变）的前提下显著加速锥束CT变分重建。
